description: This file declares the 'socket_thread' class, which manages socket communication in a threaded environment, including handling messages, socket connections, and select timeouts within the 'beerocks' namespace.

classes.name: socket_thread
classes.description: A class managing socket communication in a threaded environment, providing mechanisms for message handling, socket management, and timeout control within the 'beerocks' namespace.

methods.name: socket_thread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the socket_thread with an optional Unix socket path.

methods.name: ~socket_thread
methods.description: Destructor for socket_thread.

methods.name: set_server_max_connections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of server connections.

methods.name: set_select_timeout
methods.description: Sets the select timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the socket thread.

methods.name: thread_init
methods.description: Performs thread-specific initialization, default returns true.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Main work function for the thread.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Handles incoming CMDU messages, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: custom_message_handler
methods.description: Handles custom messages, default returns false.

methods.name: skip_filtered_message_type
methods.description: Determines if a message type should be skipped, default returns false.

methods.name: print_cmdu_types
methods.description: Returns a string representation of CMDU types.

methods.name: before_select
methods.description: Hook called before select operation.

methods.name: after_select
methods.description: Hook called after select operation.

methods.name: socket_connected
methods.description: Handles socket connection event.

methods.name: socket_disconnected
methods.description: Handles socket disconnection, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: server_port
methods.description: Returns server port, default -1.

methods.name: add_socket
methods.description: Adds a socket to the select set.

methods.name: remove_socket
methods.description: Removes a socket from the select set.

methods.name: clear_ready
methods.description: Clears the ready state of a socket.

methods.name: read_ready
methods.description: Checks if a socket is ready for reading.

methods.name: skip_next_select_timeout
methods.description: Skips the next select timeout cycle.

methods.name: awake_timeout
methods.description: Calculates a timeout point set to 50% of the select timeout duration.
